units.source_text: “我们回到各自的房间后，就没有再照面。

en.t: After we returned to our separate rooms, we did not see each other again.

units.source_text: K同上午一样悄无声息，我也一直在思考这件事。

en.t: K was as silent as he had been that morning, and I too kept thinking about what had happened.

units.source_text: 我想，应该向K表明自己的内心，

en.t: I thought that I ought to reveal my true feelings to K,

units.source_text: 可又觉得现在坦白，已经错过时机了。

en.t: but I also felt that the moment for confessing had already passed.

units.source_text: 刚才我为什么不打断他的话，发起反击呢，这似乎是个很大的失策。

en.t: Why had I not interrupted him just then and launched a counterattack? It seemed like a serious blunder.

units.source_text: 至少在K说完之后，当场把自己的心事说出来，也许还好些。

en.t: At least if I had spoken my own mind on the spot after K finished, it might still have been better.

units.source_text: 如今K已经表白完了，自己再去作同样的倾诉，怎么琢磨都觉得不妥。

en.t: Now that K had already made his confession, it felt wrong no matter how I considered it for me to make the same sort of disclosure.

units.source_text: 我找不到什么更顺理成章的办法可以克服眼下的状态，

en.t: I could find no more natural way to overcome the situation before me,

units.source_text: 我被悔恨折磨得头昏脑涨。

en.t: I was so tormented by regret that my head reeled.

units.source_text: 我想，要是K再次打开隔扇，跑来找我说话就好了。

en.t: I wished K would open the sliding door again and come over to talk to me.

units.source_text: 其实，刚才我就等于是遭到了突然袭击，

en.t: In truth, what had happened a moment before was no different from a surprise attack,

units.source_text: 没有半点应付他这一招的精神准备。

en.t: and I had not been mentally prepared in the slightest to meet that move of his.

units.source_text: 我暗下决心，要把上午失去的东西夺回来。

en.t: I secretly resolved to take back what I had lost that morning.

units.source_text: 所以不时抬起头去看隔扇。

en.t: So from time to time I raised my head and looked at the sliding door.

units.source_text: 然而那隔扇却始终没有拉开，

en.t: But that sliding door never opened,

units.source_text: K那边一直是静悄悄的。

en.t: and K's side remained completely silent.

units.source_text: 我的心渐渐被这寂静扰乱了。

en.t: Little by little, this silence began to disturb my heart.

units.source_text: 一想到K正在隔扇那边想着什么，

en.t: When I thought of K on the other side of the sliding door, wondering what he might be thinking,

units.source_text: 我便坐立不安。

en.t: I could not sit still.

units.source_text: 虽然平时我们总是这样隔着一道隔扇没有声息，

en.t: Ordinarily, we were often silent like this, separated by a single sliding door,

units.source_text: 但以往的常态是，K越是安静，我就越是忘记他的存在，

en.t: but in the usual state of things, the quieter K was, the more I forgot his presence,

units.source_text: 可见我当时已经失去了常态。

en.t: which shows that I had already lost my normal composure then.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，我绝不会主动去打开隔扇。

en.t: Even so, I absolutely would not open the sliding door on my own.

units.source_text: 一旦错过了告白的时机，

en.t: Once I had missed the chance to confess,

units.source_text: 我就只有等待对方再来找我了。

en.t: all I could do was wait for the other person to come to me again.
